presentation.short_description: An ECC memory module is no longer operating reliably.

illustration.alt_text: A server DIMM marked with a diagnostic warning.

entities.education_text: A failed DIMM can cause ECC errors, instability, reduced memory, or POST failure.

presentation.short_description: A server power supply can no longer deliver required power.

illustration.alt_text: A hot-swap PSU showing a fault indicator.

entities.education_text: A failed PSU may cause no power, redundancy warnings, or unexpected shutdowns.

presentation.short_description: The server does not successfully complete its Power-On Self-Test.

illustration.alt_text: Server powered on without completing POST.

entities.description: Power may be present, but firmware initialization does not complete normally.

presentation.short_description: The server shows no normal response to an attempted power-on.

illustration.alt_text: A server chassis with no power indicators.

entities.description: No expected fans, LEDs, POST activity, or normal power-on behavior.
